title: Relying on the Metrics of Evaluated Agents
reasoning: The paper discusses privacy in terms of its economic value and as a technical mechanism (garbling, differential privacy) within an agency game. While it briefly mentions 'inherent social value of privacy,' it does not focus on evaluating or benchmarking ethical principles, morals, or religious/spiritual aspects. The core of the paper is an economic model of information transfer incentives and metric design, not an ethical evaluation framework.
